cs.t: Get a UPS like the link below and connect the USB device cable ( not the charging port, the one on the back ). MacOS will allow you to configure the point at which it shuts down after power loss. It's a built-in function, so you don't need additional software or drivers.  https://www.newegg.com/apc-be600m1-5-x-nema-5-15r-2-x-nema-5...
cs.th: Ask HN: Make sure a desktop computer doesn't shutdown because of power outage

cs.t: I own two Back-UPS 1400VA units, one monitored with apcupsd and the other with a MikroTik router - so I guess it's just the newer units that have this issue?
cs.th: I don't think the cheapest APC Back-UPS units can be monitored except in Windows
